articles.title: xAI releases Grok-4.3 with native long-horizon agent scaffolding
articles.excerpt: New model demonstrates 4.2× improvement on multi-step software engineering benchmarks and sustains coherent agent trajectories beyond 110k tokens.

articles.title: Baseten Releases joey-1, a 2B Decision Model at $0.01 per 1M Tokens
articles.excerpt: Baseten has released joey-1, a 2B open-weight decision model that returns calibrated probabilities instead of text.  It runs at 20 ms P50 latency and costs $0

articles.title: Figure 03 completes 43-hour autonomous factory shift with zero interventions
articles.excerpt: Humanoid achieves new milestone in unsupervised operation, performing 1,240 unique tasks across three assembly lines at the BMW South Carolina plant.

articles.title: Prime Intellect Releases Prime Mega MoE: Trainable Fused MoE Kernel, 3.11x Faster Forward Pass
articles.excerpt: Prime Intellect released Prime Mega MoE, a backward pass for DeepSeek’s fused Mega MoE kernel.  It makes the kernel trainable and speeds Qwen3 MoE training steps by up to 34% in prime-rl

articles.title: Anthropic publishes unprecedented mechanistic interpretability map of Claude 4
articles.excerpt: Researchers reverse-engineered 312 million features inside the model, including the first clear "deception circuit" discovered in a frontier model.

articles.title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents
articles.excerpt: Infini-AI-Lab released Hermit, an Apache-2. 0 harness adapter framework that trains an external layer of instructions, skills, memory and tools from task feedback, leaving the agent’s model and harness unchanged

articles.title: Block Unveils Dessa, a Full-Duplex Speech Model Trained Only on Speech
articles.excerpt: Block’s AI lab released Dessa, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model trained only on human conversation audio.  It runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max, but Block has published no size, benchmarks or weights
